tasks.title: Implement project folder suffix in root title
tasks.description:
Update the Web UI root route to include the project directory basename in `document.title`.

Concrete steps:
1. In `packages/plan-web-ui/src/app/root.tsx`, compute `folder` from `project.projectRoot` using the last segment of the path (avoid importing `node:path` in the browser bundle).
2. Change title assignment to:
   - If `project.name` exists and `folder` differs from it: `${project.name} · ${folder}`
   - Else if `project.name` exists: `${project.name} · Agent Plan`
   - Else: `Agent Plan`
3. Keep the error boundary title as `Agent Plan`.
4. Run `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/web-ui build` and `pnpm check`.
5. Push to branch and create PR to `next`.

---
**Completion summary:**
Updated packages/plan-web-ui/src/app/root.tsx to derive folder name from project.projectRoot and set document.title to 'Project Name · folder' when folder differs from project name. Build and type-check pass. Branch feat/web-ui-page-title-project-folder pushed.

tasks.title: Show project folder in Web UI page title
tasks.description:
The Web UI page title currently shows only `${project.name} · Agent Plan`. User requests that the project folder path be included in the page title (e.g. 'projectName · /path/to/project · Agent Plan' or similar).

Code references:
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/app/root.tsx (where document.title is set)
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/api.ts (Project type, normalizeProject)
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/types.ts (Project interface)

Acceptance: browser tab title includes the project folder when a project is loaded. Keep it readable and not too long for narrow tabs. Use projectRoot or project.projectRoot.

---

Title now shows 'ProjectName · folder' when project.projectRoot basename differs from project name, otherwise 'ProjectName · Agent Plan'.
